name: Angel Maid
source:
Main character wakes up in an unfamiliar house and with no memory. He is taught the work from the maids and starts to work on a regular basis. However, his judgment ability is lacking and he ends up creating more work for the maids to tackle. He spends his days in such activities while trying to regain his memory...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在陌生宅邸中醒来，并且失去了记忆。女仆们教他如何工作，他也开始定期履行职责。然而，他缺乏判断力，结果总是给女仆们增添更多麻烦。他一边过着这样的日子，一边设法找回记忆…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
